# Blastwave Impact Checklist

| Scale | Question | Affected set | No-effect set | Unknown set | State | Evidence | Next |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| MICRO | Did the changed primitive itself remain correct and usable? | | | | | | |
| MESO | Did its owning workflow, sibling primitives, templates, validators and aftercare remain correct? | | | | | | |
| MACRO | Which products, adopters, runtimes and human deliverables consume this behavior? | | | | | | |
| META | Can a fresh worker/person recover and use the new truth without archaeology or owner restatement? | | | | | | |

## Closure
All applicable scales must be terminal. UNKNOWN does not become NO_EFFECT. A MICRO fix cannot close MESO, MACRO or META.
